conviction_note: Q3 bookings (97.8m PLN, +5% q/q, +15% y/y) came out in an ESPI report on 2026-10-05, so the release adds the cost side: marketing spend, adjusted EBITDA and October trading. The only sourced pointers on those (management's own 'renewed marketing scaling' for Fishing Clash and Medal Hunter, a weak September in Fishing Clash and a slow Medal Hunter ramp) lean slightly negative and are already public, and I found no PAP consensus for the quarter. So p_up is 46 against an abs_move of 5.0, which rests on this name's own results-day moves (+3.65, -6.55, -6.70, +3.84 on the last four prints, all of them after pre-released bookings) and its thin turnover. That gives -0.4. The findings sum to -0.9 and agree in sign; they are larger because each one carries its own small size, while the scaled number holds the sign uncertainty.

Management said Fishing Clash KPIs support 'renewed marketing scaling' and Medal Hunter 'enters marketing scaling'

new_in_release.expect: Marketing spend and adj. EBITDA. Bookings rose only about 4.5m q/q while management signalled more user-acquisition spend on Fishing Clash and Medal Hunter, so I expect EBITDA flat to down against Q2's 21.4m. Mildly negative against an unknown bar.

October bookings commentary. The H1 release carried July, so this one probably carries October. September was the weakest month of the quarter (31.1m, Fishing Clash 13.1m against 16.2m in August). Direction unknown, slight negative lean.
First KPI and payback read on Medal Hunter after launch (1.2m and 1.4m PLN bookings in its first two full months). Unknown, slight negative lean.
Operating cash flow close to EBITDA, as in Q2. No change expected.
TSG gives no numeric guidance. None expected.
Deferred to year-end under the policy. None expected.

bar: unsourced. I found no PAP Biznes consensus for Q3 2026 adj. EBITDA, which is usually published the day before the report. The only broker numbers seen are Noble Securities (23.07.2026, Buy, TP 152.7, FY2026 EBITDA 76m PLN, which implies about 18m a quarter in H2: https://www.biznesradar.pl/storage/a/te/n-/ten-noble-2026-07-23-disc-2f501ba.pdf) and BOS DM Hold 84.18 from 2025-12-01. Every finding is capped small because of this.

findings.finding: In the H1 release management said Fishing Clash KPIs support 'renewed marketing scaling' and that Medal Hunter (global launch 30 July) 'enters marketing scaling'. Bookings rose only about 4.5m PLN q/q, so a return of Q3 marketing toward the Q1 level of 32.4m (from Q2's 25.9m) would leave adj. EBITDA flat to below Q2's 21.4m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EBITDA against consensus has moved this name on results day. Q2 2026 beat by 7.1%: +3.84%. Q1 2026 beat slightly but EBITDA fell 38% y/y: -6.70%. Q4 2025 missed (18.5 vs 20.8): -6.55% on the FY report. Q3 2025 missed (22.1 vs 23.7): +3.65%. Mixed signs, large sizes.
findings.original_quote: W Fishing Clash poprawa KPI wspiera powrót do aktywniejszego wsparcia marketingowego ... Ten Square Games wchodzi obecnie w fazę skalowania marketingowego tego tytułu [In Fishing Clash, KPI improvement supports a return to more active marketing support ... Ten Square Games is now entering the marketing-scaling phase of this title (Medal Hunter)]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The statement is public and the two or three covering brokers will have modelled more marketing, so the residual is how big the spend was, which nobody outside the company has seen. Noble's July model assumed Medal Hunter would launch in 1Q27 and so carried no Q3 UA for it; if the consensus leaned on stale models it sits too high. If the market had fully priced an EBITDA dip, the stock would not have drifted down only after mid-October; it has fallen 8.9% over 20 sessions, which is consistent with partial pricing. The bar is unsourced, so the size is capped.
findings.independence: Noble Securities 2026-07-23 expected Medal Hunter in 1Q27, so marketing for it was absent from that model: https://www.biznesradar.pl/storage/a/te/n-/ten-noble-2026-07-23-disc-2f501ba.pdf. Quartr Q2 summary for marketing of 25.9m (+103% y/y): https://quartr.com/events/ten-square-games-sa-ten-q2-2026_3eBWYrFo

findings.finding: The monthly split in the 3Q bookings report shows a weak exit to the quarter. September group bookings were 31.1m against 34.6m in August, Fishing Clash 13.1m against 16.2m (-19% m/m) despite the stated marketing push, and Medal Hunter only 1.2m and 1.4m in its first two full months. The release is likely to comment on October trading and the first Medal Hunter payback read, and both start from a soft base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 release's positive July commentary ('positive signals in July') came with a +3.84% reaction on 2026-08-25. There is no prior case of negative current-trading commentary on this name in the sample.
findings.original_quote: wrzesień 2026: 31,1 mln PLN, w tym Fishing Clash - 13,1 mln PLN ... a Medal Hunter - 1,4 mln PLN [September 2026: 31.1m PLN, of which Fishing Clash 13.1m ... and Medal Hunter 1.4m]
findings.why_not_priced: The monthly figures are public, so this is mostly priced. The unpriced part is October and management's verdict on Medal Hunter's unit economics, which only the release carries. The stock's fall after mid-October (-3.5% on 10-19 and -4.5% on 10-22 on 51k shares, with no company news found) suggests some of the weakness is already in. An unexplained drawdown is worth 0 by itself, so it is not filed as a finding.
findings.independence: The same document as finding 1 for the numbers; the 'positive signals in July' claim in the 2026-08-24 release is the contrast (https://tensquaregames.com/2026/08/24/ten-square-games-groups-financial-results-for-q2-2026-stronger-core-portfolio-progress-in-product-line-development-and-cost-discipline/). Nothing independent points the same way.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative. That agrees in sign with the -8.9% 20-day and -13.7% 60-day momentum and runs against the run-up control's small positive mean-reversion lean (+0.44). With no positioning anchor, the sign is held near 50.
language_note: The Q3 bookings pre-release, including the monthly and per-game split behind finding 3, exists only as a Polish ESPI report (raport bieżący 16/2026); I found no English version.
The company calendar (9 November) and the session evidence (17:03 and 17:04 release timestamps) came from Polish sources (Biznesradar's ESPI feed).
The PAP-consensus comparisons for past quarters (Q3'25 22.1 vs 23.7; Q4'25 18.5 vs 20.8; Q1'26 18.9 vs 18.1; Q2'26 21.4 vs 20) are Polish press only.

The English sources (the company's EN release, Quartr) carried the Q2 marketing figure and the same management wording; they added the 25.9m marketing number in a convenient form but no fact the Polish sources lacked.
lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding': the September Fishing Clash exit rate (-0.4) and the Medal Hunter ramp (-0.3) both rested on the 3Q bookings ESPI report, so they were merged into one finding at -0.5.
'An unsourced bar caps every finding': the marketing/EBITDA finding moved from -0.5 to -0.4.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the bookings finding stays at 0.0. It is filed only so the pre-release is visible.

'Understatement' and 'size the move on what is new; history moves p_up, not abs_move': abs_move rose from 4.5 to 5.0 on the name's own results-day moves (median about 5.2% across the last four prints, all after pre-released bookings) and thin turnover ($182k/day). p_up moved from 45 to 46, because the period is pre-released, no guide is expected and the reaction signs are mixed.
